interpretation_limits: The four-layer wider allocation has lower TEST NLL in all three paired runs; both depth and width differ, so this is not proof about depth alone or TAC versus another architecture.
Continuous-carry measurements preserve all carried components, including local KV; their differences do not identify an associative-bank-specific causal contribution.
Three paired seeds on one text split are not independent task replications; no confidence interval, significance test or superiority claim is added.
Inference speed uses a small CPU synthetic resource fixture, not GPU throughput, an application workload, or complete training/inference FLOPs.
Physical carried-state bytes include all persistent model tensors and local KV, not model weights or training activation memory.
Generated text is illustrative; if shown use predeclared seed 10601 for each arm, preserve its actual newlines, and do not treat fluency as a capability score.
Original RESULT.json and its generated files are not modified.
